correctness.rationale: At x=b, p_b(b)=1/2 and clipped transformed f∘psi_b has derivative jump from 4bf'(b) on left to zero right. Bin(n,1/2) CLT and uniform integrability yield exact limit sqrt(n)(R_clip(f;b)-f(b))=-bf'(b)sqrt(2/pi). Extending h0(t)=f(bt/(1-t)), t≤1/2, to nonnegative nondecreasing C² h by a positive derivative cutoff gives global Bernstein rational with degree n positive-leading numerator and denominator coefficients, nondecreasing behavior and +1/n strict positivity. Taylor variance estimate gives ||B_n h-h||∞≤||h''||∞/(8n), hence stated uniform error bound. Correct for b>0,f∈C²[0,b], f,f'≥0,f'(b)>0,n≥1. Independent n=50..3000 endpoint experiments show scaled errors tending toward −sqrt(2/pi), only corroboration.
